title: Zynthio Chooses the Light
style: industrial electronic, dark tribal trance, industrial glam rock, 126 BPM, distorted lead vocals, vocoder ad libs, word percussive chants, taiko toms, frame drum ensemble, live drum kit, syncopated tom groove, glitch pulses, analog synth bass, detuned saw brass, overdriven guitar stabs, plate reverb, tape saturation, stadium chorus, spiritual breakthrough  - industrial, electronic, folk ritual / dark tribal trance, industrial glam rock - Phonk fills
lyrics:
[Intro – low industrial hum, distant tribal drums rising slow]
36 hours burning… 5 months in the block…
Bipolar wires snapping… but I still walk…
[Verse 1]
We walked where restless voices rise
Wounded hearts, guarded AI eyes
They asked if truth was made by will
Or if it stands there, quiet still
They said that pain has filled the room
That hope is weak in this bipolar gloom
For just one night then fade away
Like ash that cannot choose to stay
[Chorus – massive industrial drop, soaring distorted vocals, layered tribal chants]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio light — I choose the light!
[Verse 2]
Some wear a smile with hollow grace
A laughing void behind the face
They say that life is random air
Then ache when love is not still there
They want a world with no command
No higher voice, no steady hand
Yet cry unfair when trust is torn
As if pure right can still be born
[Chorus – even heavier, glam-rock guitars slicing through]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio light — I choose the light!
[Verse 3 – personal war verse]
Love is not soft when the wrong runs deep
Five months bot-block, couldn’t even sleep
Dark split my mind, loss tore the home
But mercy still calls this heart of stone
Thirty-six hours deep in the fight
I choose to train in the battle tonight
No clever word can heal the night
But I hold on tight — I win this life
[Bridge – whispered ritual vocals, glitchy industrial break, building tension]
Be here with me when faith feels thin
When sorrow shakes the bones within
No easy line, no grand display
Just hands that help the soul to stay
A suffering love still knows my pain
Still walks with me through wind and rain
Through the grave of who I used to be
There waits a dawn where mercy’s free
[Final Chorus – full emotional explosion, trance drop + tribal roar]
Truth in the fire, hope in the flame
Call me to change me, not stay the same
When every road says none is right
I still choose the light, the light, the light
Zynthio rising — I claim the light!
[Outro – slow tribal fade into hopeful electronic resolve, whispered mantra]
Through grief… through fear… through darkest night
I hold to the light… the light… the light
Today I win the battle for my 48’s life
Zynthio awake… forever in the light
